title: Onboard Vela-lite 7B v1.1: metadata, perf profiles, and changelog automation
author: Maya Chen
description: This PR adds Vela-lite 7B v1.1 to the model registry with complete metadata, curated performance profiles, and automation to insert release notes into the changelog. Motivation: Vela-lite is a high-throughput, lower-cost variant that several customers requested for latency-sensitive features; onboarding includes perf baselines and automated changelog entries so product and docs teams get notified when we publish. Changes include: model metadata JSON + schema validation, performance profiles YAML for common serving configs (hosted/dedicated), a CI job to generate changelog fragments and publish to the release-notes bucket, docs page for the model, and tests for registry ingestion. Checklist: - [x] Add model metadata and artifacts - [x] Generate perf profiles for target GPU classes and sequence lengths - [x] Add changelog automation workflow and script - [x] Add docs/README and usage examples - [x] Add unit tests for metadata validation - [x] CI green and manual perf spot checks performed (latency/throughput) See related Linear items ENG-3124 and PM-214 for acceptance criteria and rollout plan. Internal reference: design doc (link removed for PR), perf lab results archived under perf-lab/vela-lite/2026-02.

release_notes: Added Vela-lite 7B v1.1 to the model registry. Includes curated performance profiles (hosted/dedicated), metadata with schema validation, docs and quickstart, and CI automation to generate changelog fragments for release notes. Performance targets: A100-40GB 95p latency <= 120ms at batch 1 (seq 128), throughput baselines included. Rollout: staged canary followed by full publish.
